title: Founder Runtime Approval Application Authority Activation Boundary
objective: Define the governed approval application authority activation boundary before any live authority can be considered, while keeping activation, approval application, DB/runtime writes, execution, provider calls, project mutation, deploy, package, network, and spend blocked.
safetyRules: Do not enable approval application authority activation in P123.1.
Do not enable approval decision application, approval capture, approval persistence, or approve/reject decision recording in P123.1.
Do not enable DB writes, hosted DB mutation, raw SQL, runtime writes, runtime execution, or execution unlock in P123.1.
Do not call providers/models, dispatch agents, execute workers/tools, mutate projects, deploy, release, export, package, use network calls, or spend in P123.1.
Do not change Command Center source or dashboard tests in P123.1.
Do not expose DemoApp, raw JSON/log/policy dumps, raw private IDs, raw DB names, raw report paths in primary UX, fake runnable actions, or mutation controls.
Future P123 subphases must define narrow authority, validation, UX, rollback, and explicit operator evidence before any later phase can consider live behavior.
knownLimitations: P123.1 is contract/policy only and does not enable live authority.
Command Center source and dashboard tests are intentionally unchanged in P123.1.

Approval application authority activation, approval decision application, approval capture, approval persistence, approve/reject decision recording, DB/runtime writes, runtime execution, execution unlock, provider/model calls, agent dispatch, worker/tool execution, project mutation, hosted DB mutation, raw SQL, deploy, release, export, package, network calls, and provider spend remain blocked.

subphases.title: Activation Boundary Contract / Policy
subphases.narrowGoal: Create the P123 implementation-grade activation boundary contract, subphase split, safety rules, reuse requirements, validation commands, docs, and status handoff without enabling live authority.
subphases.dataShape: No runtime exports, schemas, DB tables, or data model changes. P123.1 defines contract metadata and planned subphase shapes only.
subphases.commandCenterUx: Preserve existing Command Center UX. No new cards, routes, controls, or labels are introduced in P123.1.
themeRequirements: Run existing P122.5 focused Playwright coverage as route/theme regression.
playwrightTests: Do not edit dashboard tests in P123.1 because dashboard/test paths are forbidden.
Run existing focused Playwright test: Approval application authority handoff appears only on scoped pages.
checkerUpdates: Add a P123.1 contract/policy checker using shared/reportWriter.js and shared/checkResultFormatter.js.
Update the P122.7 checker to accept P123.1 handoff.
Update OS phase status checker to recognize P123.1-P123.7.
Validate contract shape, P122 handoff, planned P123 subphases, status/docs/report alignment, forbidden paths, no dashboard source/test edits, and unsafe claim prevention.
subphases.docsRoadmap: Create P123 plan, update README, platform roadmap, OS status, generated reports, and P123 contract for P123.1.
subphases.phaseStatusUpdate: P123 in progress; P123.1 complete; current phase P123.1; previous P122.7; next P123.2.
validationCommands: cd dashboard && npx playwright test tests/routes.spec.js -g "Approval application authority handoff appears only on scoped pages"
gitCommands: git commit -m "feat(nexus): implement p1231 approval authority activation contract"
stamp P123/P123.1 status with the implementation commit
git commit -m "chore(nexus): stamp p1231 approval authority activation contract"
finalSafetyChecks: Confirm no project/CareLoop/generated project paths changed.
Confirm no Command Center source or dashboard test files changed.
Confirm no DB/runtime provider, tool, worker, deploy, release, export, package, local runtime state, or env paths changed.

Confirm no activation, approval decision application, approval capture, approval persistence, approve/reject decision recording, DB/runtime writes, runtime execution, execution unlock, provider/model calls, agent dispatch, worker/tool execution, project mutation, hosted DB mutation, raw SQL, deploy, release, export, package, network calls, or provider spend are enabled.
Confirm no stale pending-final-commit remains after the status stamp commit.
